esg.title: ESG Tracking & Board Dashboard for NSL Foods
esg.summary: A unified ESG operating system for a publicly-listed food manufacturer — sustainability reporting that meets global frameworks and board scrutiny.
esg.challenge: NSL Foods PLC needed one centralized platform to track Environmental, Social, and Governance activities across all operations, ensure compliance with global sustainability standards, and produce board-grade reporting on demand.
esg.solution: We delivered a user-friendly web platform with intuitive UX, real-time data ingestion across the supply chain, and an executive dashboard designed specifically for board committees and audit reviewers.
esg.result: Streamlined ESG data collection, real-time visibility into sustainability KPIs, board-ready reports aligned with global standards, and dramatically improved governance transparency.

rd.title: R&D Performance Executive Dashboard
rd.summary: A real-time executive view into R&D spend, milestone progress, and research velocity — built for a major food and beverage manufacturer.
rd.challenge: Executives needed visibility into R&D workloads, project milestone progress, and overall research performance to make informed investment decisions — across a portfolio that had previously lived in spreadsheets.
rd.solution: We built an intuitive realtime dashboard with executive-grade infographics. The system tracks R&D workload distribution, goal accomplishment, milestone progress, and resource utilization across every active research project.
rd.result: Enhanced executive visibility into R&D performance, sharper milestone tracking, better resource allocation, and a clearer line of communication between R&D teams and the leadership team.

payroll.title: PayrollITH — Confidential Payroll for Thai SMEs
payroll.summary: A secure, fast, web-based payroll platform built for Thai SMEs that need an affordable alternative to enterprise accounting suites — and absolute payroll confidentiality.
payroll.challenge: SMEs in Thailand face a tough choice: pay for expensive accounting software or OEM systems that are over-engineered and costly to scale, or manage payroll manually with all the risks that entails. Businesses needing payroll confidentiality have even fewer options at a reasonable price.
payroll.solution: PayrollITH is a purpose-built web application developed using full-stack technologies known for security and fast response times. It gives SMEs a lightweight, affordable payroll platform without the overhead of a full accounting suite — payroll data stays isolated and confidential, accessible only to authorized personnel.
payroll.result: Affordable payroll management without enterprise licensing, confidential payroll separated from other business systems, fast secure web-based access from anywhere, and a solution that scales with the business.

smartinventory.title: SmartInventory — Lot-Level Intelligence Above SAP
smartinventory.summary: Built a lot-level inventory intelligence platform that surfaced ฿14.9M in invisible expired stock on day one — a layer above SAP, not a replacement.
smartinventory.challenge: NSL Food Service had ฿14.9M in expired inventory hidden inside their SAP system. No lot-level tracking. Manual Excel handoffs broke whenever an operations staffer turned over. GMP/HACCP auditors flagged batch traceability gaps year after year.
smartinventory.solution: We built SmartInventory as an intelligence layer above SAP — lot-level expiry tracking, a proprietary VV Matrix (Value × Validity) scoring engine, FEFO automation, and three analysis modes (Lot, Worst-Case, Weighted) for ops, procurement, and finance to share the same data and reach different conclusions.
smartinventory.result: ฿8.5M of dead stock cleared in the first three months. Reorder cycle dropped from 30 to 14 days. First GMP/HACCP audit passed cleanly. Operations team replaced Excel chaos with a daily FEFO pick list. Boardroom now sees inventory health in one glance.

brief.title: The Brief
brief.p1: Centralize fragmented ESG data — Energy, GHG, Water, Waste, Social, and Governance — across multiple branches and production facilities into a single source of truth.
brief.p2: Replace spreadsheets and PDF compilations with a governed platform that supports role-based access, auditability, and on-demand exports for executive review and external reporting.

shots.loginDesc: Glass-morphism authentication with bilingual support, climate-action positioning, and live sustainability commitments visible at sign-in.
shots.dashboardDesc: Top-level KPIs — companies, sites, metrics — plus real-time user analytics: submission velocity, peak hours, peak day, and hourly/daily trend charts that update as data flows in.
shots.envDesc: End-to-end environmental view — GHG (Scope 1+2), Total Electricity, Renewables %, Water Withdrawal, Total Waste, Waste Diversion Rate — sliced by Company, Site, and Year with year-over-year deltas.

features.f3Desc: Submission analytics, hourly activity, peak times, and per-user contribution surfaced in real time.
features.f4Desc: One-click executive exports — TV View for screens, Excel for offline review, ready for assurance.

smartinventory.tagline: Lot-level inventory intelligence for food service operators.

brief.title: The Brief
brief.p1: NSL Food Service had ฿14.9M in expired stock hidden inside their SAP system — no lot-level tracking, manual Excel handoffs that broke whenever an operations staffer turned over. Auditors flagged batch traceability gaps in GMP/HACCP reviews.
brief.p2: We built SmartInventory as an intelligence layer on top of SAP — lot-level expiry tracking, VV Matrix scoring (Value × Validity), FEFO automation, and three boardroom-ready analysis modes. ฿8.5M of dead stock cleared in the first three months.

shots.loginDesc: Dark executive-grade sign-in surface with a live network map of warehouses. System status, audit trail, and multi-tenant isolation badges visible before sign-in.
shots.dashboardDesc: Working capital, inventory turnover, days inventory, dead-stock %, and VV Matrix class breakdown — surfaced in a single board-grade view with MoM and QoQ deltas.
shots.vvMatrixDesc: Proprietary scoring engine that grades every lot by stock value and days-to-expiry. Three analysis modes — By Lot, Item Worst-Case, and Item Weighted — answer different boardroom questions from the same data.
shots.fefoDesc: First-Expired-First-Out pick list with aging buckets (expired, ≤30d, 31–60d, 61–90d, 91–180d, >180d). Warehouse teams pick from the right batch every time — no spreadsheet required.

features.title: What's Inside
features.f1Desc: Unique Value × Validity scoring engine — surfaces the riskiest lots first. Configurable α exponent for industry-specific sensitivity.
features.f2Desc: By Lot for ops, Worst-Case for procurement, Weighted for finance — the same data, three boardroom angles.
features.f3Desc: First-Expired-First-Out pick lists generated daily. Warehouse teams pick the right batch without guesswork.
features.f4Desc: Full lot-level traceability and audit trail. Passes food-safety audits that ERPs typically fail.
